  workflow_dispatch:

          KIT
          tar xzf kit.tgz && chmod +x KAYALI-region-pack-kit/build_region_pack.sh && ls -R KAYALI-region-pack-kit | head -20
      - name: Make room
        run: sudo rm -rf /usr/share/dotnet /usr/local/lib/android /opt/ghc /opt/hostedtoolcache/CodeQL /usr/local/share/boost && df -h /
      - uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with: { distribution: temurin, java-version: "21" }
      - name: Tools
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y osmium-tool zip
          pip install pyvalhalla==3.6.3 duckdb osmium
      - name: Build ${{ matrix.en }}
        working-directory: KAYALI-region-pack-kit
        env:
          ID: ${{ matrix.id }}
          NAME_AR: ${{ matrix.ar }}
          NAME_EN: ${{ matrix.en }}
          BBOX: ${{ matrix.bbox }}
          PBF_URL: ${{ matrix.pbf }}
          JAVA_MEM: 10g
          PACK_URL: https://github.com/${{ github.repository }}/releases/download/packs/${{ matrix.id }}.zip
        run: ./build_region_pack.sh && rm -rf work-*
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with: { name: "${{ matrix.id }}", path: "KAYALI-region-pack-kit/${{ matrix.id }}.*", retention-days: 3 }
  publish:
    needs: build
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with: { path: out, merge-multiple: true }
      - name: Catalogue
        run: |
          python3 -c "
          import json, glob
          p = []
          for f in sorted(glob.glob('out/*.json')):
              d = json.load(open(f)); p.append({'id': d['id'], 'url': 'https://github.com/${{ github.repository }}/releases/download/packs/' + d['id'] + '.json', 'size': str(round(d['bytes'] / 1e6)) + ' MB'})
          json.dump({'packs': p}, open('out/catalog.json', 'w'), ensure_ascii=False)
          print(p)
          "
      - name: Publish the packs release
        env: { GH_TOKEN: "${{ github.token }}" }
        run: |
          gh release view packs -R "${{ github.repository }}" >/dev/null 2>&1 || gh release create packs -R "${{ github.repository }}" -t "KAYALI region packs" -n "Built automatically every month."
          gh release upload packs out/* -R "${{ github.repository }}" --clobber
